run_chat_interactive: run an interactive chat session with a specified model and streaming responses
run_chat_with_temperature: run an interactive chat session with custom temperature and system message settings
run_chat_switch_model: run an interactive chat session and switch models mid-conversation using /model command
run_chat_save_load: run an interactive chat session and save or load conversation history from JSON files
run_chat_stream_response: run a streaming chat response that prints tokens in real-time and returns complete content
